intended_object: A comparison isomorphism, one open set at a time. For q > 0 it identifies the local cohomology H^q(f⁻¹V, G) with the value at V of the presheaf V ↦ H^q(Γ(V, f_* I^•)), where I^• is a fixed injective resolution of G. This is inferred from the docstring and from how the file uses it.
